sampling_frequency_reconciliation.reconciliation_explanation: The 20,688 decision records and 627 simulation trades originate from two distinct, rigorously defined sampling protocols: 1. Decision intelligence and opportunity cost research sampled the multi-year history every 24 bars (2 hours), recording 20,688 static decision states, of which 20,157 (97.43%) were WAIT_USDT. 2. Economic replay simulation stepped through the multi-year interval every 12 bars (1 hour), evaluating 40,000 chronological steps. Out of 40,000 steps, exactly 627 trades were executed, representing a trade frequency of 1.57% of evaluated bars. The two metrics are completely compatible.

signal_to_execution_traceability.chain: Market State -> Decision -> Portfolio State -> Order -> Fill -> Updated Portfolio
